settings.a: Orders are processed within 1 to 3 business days. Delivery usually takes 5 to 10 business days from dispatch.

settings.q: Do you offer cash on delivery?
settings.a: Yes, cash on delivery is available.
Shipping is free on orders above ₹499.
Orders can be cancelled before they have shipped. Contact us as soon as possible with your order details.
Opened products cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. If an item arrives damaged, defective or incorrect, tell us within 7 days of delivery with photos or a video.
